products.name: FixAi
products.heroTitle: Smarter Home Maintenance, Powered by AI
products.heroDescription: FixAi helps homeowners track appliances, stay ahead of maintenance, and troubleshoot problems using AI — all in one simple place.
heroPoints: Understand issues before they become expensive repairs
Keep appliance details, manuals, and history organized
Get AI guidance in plain English, anytime
problemParagraphs: Most homeowners don't ignore maintenance — they simply don't have a system.
Maintenance schedules get forgotten. Appliance manuals disappear. Problems are noticed only when something breaks.
By the time you act, the cost is already higher — and the stress is unavoidable.
FixAi was built to change that.

capabilities.title: Prevent Problems Early

billingPointProduct.name: BillingPoint
billingPointProduct.heroTitle: Billing that keeps up with your counter
billingPointProduct.heroDescription: GST billing, stock and payments for Indian businesses: scan and bill at the counter, print receipts, share on WhatsApp and get paid to your own bank.
billingPointProduct.overviewTitle: One app for the busiest part of the day
overview: Restaurants, retail shops and distributors raise dozens of bills a day, often on paper or in tools built for accountants. BillingPoint puts a GST invoice, the day's sales and what customers still owe on one screen.
Bills, stock, purchases, expenses and payments live in the same place, so the numbers you need for GST returns are ready when you are.
points: GST invoices with CGST and SGST calculated automatically
Today's sales, collections and dues on the home screen
UPI, cash, NEFT, RTGS and IMPS payments with TDS tracking
Low-stock alerts and receipt scanning for expenses
billingPointProduct.billingDescription: Raise a correct GST invoice in seconds, whether it is a walk-in sale or a regular customer.

billingFeatures.title: New bill
billingFeatures.description: Add items, scan barcodes or paste an order; tax is worked out line by line.

billingFeatures.title: Walk-in or account customers
billingFeatures.description: Bill counter sales without an account, or add a buyer and mobile number for WhatsApp.

billingFeatures.title: Share and print
billingFeatures.description: Print receipts at the counter or send the invoice straight to the customer on WhatsApp.

billingFeatures.title: Daily sales dashboard
billingFeatures.description: Bills today, amount collected and amount to collect, with monthly totals and overdue dues.

billingPointProduct.operationsDescription: Everything behind the counter that keeps the books straight.

operationsFeatures.title: Record payments
operationsFeatures.description: Log UPI, cash and bank transfers against a customer, with UTR reference and TDS deducted.

operationsFeatures.title: Stock and purchases
operationsFeatures.description: Track items and purchases, and get warned before a product runs out.

operationsFeatures.title: Expenses with receipt scan
operationsFeatures.description: Photograph a bill and the expense form fills in, with category, GST rate and payment mode.

operationsFeatures.title: Reports and GST returns
operationsFeatures.description: Sales, collections and tax summaries ready for filing.
